subject: sociology

moments.title: Institute for Social Research founded
moments.body: The Institute is founded with a commitment to Marxist social analysis and interdisciplinary research.
moments.takeaway: Institutional investment can build a theoretical tradition.

moments.title: Dialectic of Enlightenment
moments.who: Adorno and Horkheimer, exile in California
moments.body: The book argues that instrumental reason produces both fascism and the culture industry. Written during exile from Nazism.
moments.takeaway: Critical theory diagnosed modernity from within its catastrophe.

moments.title: The Authoritarian Personality
moments.body: An empirical study uses the F-scale to link personality structure to fascism-receptive attitudes.
moments.takeaway: Frankfurt theorists used quantitative methods as well as critique.

now.title: Critical theory today
now.body: Habermas's communicative action and Honneth's recognition continue the Frankfurt tradition. Algorithmic culture revives 'culture industry' debates.
now.open_questions: Do platform recommender systems constitute a new culture industry?

reflection: Frankfurt critical theory developed under emergency conditions of fascism, war and exile.
